name: glider-multilingual-reward-bench-suite
description: A suite for evaluating reward models and preference prediction across many languages and scenarios. It measures how well multilingual reward models predict human preferences or rank model outputs in different languages, enabling cross-lingual comparison of reward-model quality. The benchmark is intended for assessing alignment and reward-model generalization in multilingual settings.
reputation: Relatively new and niche, used mainly by researchers working on reward modeling and multilingual alignment; modest community adoption so far.
